article.title: The drone wars come to British prisons
article.excerpt: A British prison has become the world’s first to use a new system designed to stop drones flying over perimeter walls to drop contraband into jails. The device creates a 2,000ft (600m) shield around and above a prison that will detect and deflect the remote-controlled devices.
